# LumoroX AI

> AI-powered movie discovery: trending films, reviews, ratings, synopses, trailers, mood-based discovery and personalized recommendations.

LumoroX AI helps people find what to watch next. It combines live TMDB catalogue data with a hybrid recommendation engine (content similarity + collaborative signals) and natural-language search so visitors can ask questions like "mind-bending sci-fi like Inception" and get explained recommendations.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Trending now, in cinemas, just released, top rated and coming-soon movies.
- [Search](/search): Search movies by title, genre, cast, director or keyword.
- [Ask AI](/ask): Natural-language movie search — describe a mood, plot or vibe and get matching films.
- [Mood Discovery](/mood): Browse movies by mood (feel-good, tense, romantic, epic and more).
- [Recommendations](/recommendations): Personalized picks with explanations for why each film was chosen.
- [Movie details](/movie/1): Synopsis, cast, director, runtime, rating, trailer and similar movies for any film.

## Optional

- [Watchlist](/watchlist): Personal saved-movies list (requires a signed-in session to sync).
